title: Sifatlar
hook_voice: Lesson nineteen. Big, small, good, bad.
hook_say: Katta va kichik inglizcha nima bo'ladi? Hozir o'rganamiz!

example.en: My house is big. My car is small.
example.uz: Mening uyim katta. Mening mashinam kichik.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga yigirmanchi darsda ko'rishamiz.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 19-dars: inglizcha sifatlar.

A big house — Katta uy
A small car — Kichik mashina
A good book — Yaxshi kitob

Yana bitta sifat: bad — yomon. Sifat ham o'zbekchadagi kabi narsa nomidan oldin keladi: a big house.
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 20-dars: Kundalik fe'llar.
